title: AI Engineer Tools & Automations
description: Labhouse is a Barcelona-based startup studio building AI-powered mobile apps used by hundreds of thousands of people worldwide. Our products — including Invoice Fly and Summary AI — are designed to make everyday tasks faster, smarter, and simpler through a subscription model that puts the user first.We were founded by Andrés Bou and Horacio Martos, the duo behind SocialPoint (acquired by Take-Two Interactive), and we operate with the mindset of a product company: small teams, high ownership, and a relentless focus on building things that matter.Would you like to make an impact as part of a company that builds the best mobile apps used by millions of users worldwide? If so, discover your next challenge below.The RoleAt Labhouse, AI isn't just what we ship to users — it's how we operate internally. As our AI Engineer, you'll design and build LLM-powered tools, agents, and automations that remove friction and unlock speed across the company.This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You will:Identify manual, repetitive, or slow processes and turn them into AI-powered tools and automationsDesign and build LLM-based agents that can reason, use tools, and complete multi-step tasks autonomouslyOwn projects end-to-end — from scoping the problem and understanding the business need, to designing, building, and shipping the solutionIntegrate LLMs and agents with internal systems and third-party toolsWork directly with team leads to understand where AI can unlock the most impact — and translate that into working productsMeasure the productivity and efficiency gains your work generates, and iterate based on real usageAbout YouAcademic BackgroundWe care more about what you've built than where you studied. A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is a plus, but relevant hands-on experience matters more than the diploma.What we are looking forYou've already done this before — you've walked into a company, spotted where AI could solve a real problem, and built the solution yourself, end to end. You're not looking for your first shot at this.Strong, proven experience working with LLMs in production — prompting, fine-tuning, RAG, or agent-based systemsDeep knowledge of agent frameworks and how to design multi-step, tool-using workflowsTrack record of shipping tools or automations that measurably improved productivity or performance in a companyStrong Python skills and comfort integrating APIs, webhooks, and third-party toolsBusiness vision — you understand how a company operates and can spot high-leverage opportunities for automation without being told where to lookComfortable working in fast-moving, data-heavy environments where speed and iteration matterExperience building tools or automations involving paid or organic acquisition data (campaigns, channels, attribution, or similar) is a strong plusAbility to work autonomously, prioritize based on impact, and ship without waiting for perfect conditionsAI ProficiencyYou live and breathe AI tools — not just LLM APIs, but the broader ecosystem of agents, copilots, and automation platforms. You stay on top of the state of the art and know how to turn new capabilities into practical, working tools fast.CommunicationYou communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You know how to interview a team about their pain points, translate that into a technical solution, and explain the result in terms they care about.Nice to HaveExperience with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or similar)Experience with automation/workflow platforms (n8n, Zapier, Make)Experience building tools involving data pipelines, dashboards, or reporting systemsPrior experience in a startup or fast-moving, resource-constrained environmentWhat we offerCompetitive compensation packageHybrid work model based in Barcelona, with the option to work remotely from Spain for exceptional fits. High ownership from day one — you define the direction, not just execute on itWork directly with the founders and a senior, low-ego teamReal, immediate impact — your tools will be used by every team, every dayHiring ProcessInitial Interview: Meet with our Talent Acquisition Lead to discuss your background and fit for the role. We’ll also ask you to share your proudest projects. Hiring Manager Interview: A deep dive into your experience and leadership capabilities. Technical Assessment: Showcase your expertise through a practical task. Final Interview: A conversation with our leadership team to align on vision and expectations. Offer: Join our team and lead the development of our future-shaping apps!You should Know:Labhouse is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. However you identify or whatever your journey to this point, we welcome all candidates to apply for the position that inspires them.Come join us and help us build a company that everyone is proud to be part of. title: Senior AI Engineer
description: About Refold AIRefold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants.We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.Refold AI has raised $6.5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.What you'll do:Implement memory for our AI Agents, ensuring proper context managementApply retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines to integrate LLMs with real-time data and context. Apply advanced techniques in prompt engineering, transfer learning, and custom model training. Optimise model performance and cost across production environments. Work with tools like Hugging Face, LangChain, OpenAI APIs, and vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate). Deploy scalable models using cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure, and containerization tools like Docker and Kubernetes. Collaborate with global teams and researchers in a fast-paced, remote-first setup. What we're looking for:5+ years of experience in AI/ML with deep exposure to Generative AI and LLMsExperience working in Memory Management, Context setting and RAG1-2 yrs of purely Backed SDE experience is a must for this rolePreferably from Tier 1 colleges with a background in CSE preferred Show more Show less

title: AI Engineer
company: A*STAR - Agency for Science, Technology and Research
description: Role OverviewWe are seeking an experienced AI Engineer with 5–7 years of relevant experience in machine learning, AI engineering and application development to design, build and deploy intelligent AI solutions for enterprise use cases.The successful candidate will have hands-on experience developing production-ready AI and agentic AI solutions, integrating large language models (LLMs), enterprise data, APIs, tools and business systems to automate and enhance complex workflows.This is a hands-on engineering role requiring strong technical expertise, sound software engineering practices, and the ability to translate business needs into secure, scalable and maintainable AI solutions.Key ResponsibilitiesAgentic AI EngineeringIndependently design, develop, test and deploy agentic AI solutions that can reason, plan, invoke tools and execute multi-step enterprise workflows.Build single- and multi-agent solutions incorporating LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), memory, tool/function calling, workflow orchestration and human-in-the-loop controls.Develop reusable agent components, APIs, connectors and orchestration patterns that can be applied across enterprise use cases.Integrate AI agents with enterprise applications, databases, knowledge repositories and APIs.Machine Learning & AI DevelopmentDevelop and productionise machine learning and generative AI solutions using appropriate models, frameworks and cloud AI services.Evaluate and select models based on accuracy, latency, cost, security and business requirements.Design RAG pipelines covering document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, reranking and grounding.Establish systematic evaluation approaches for AI solutions, including task completion, answer quality, groundedness, hallucination, latency and cost.Enterprise AI EngineeringTranslate business processes and workflow requirements into scalable AI solution architectures.Build AI applications using modern frameworks and technologies such as Python, REST APIs, LLM APIs, vector databases and agent orchestration frameworks.Implement appropriate authentication, authorization, observability, auditability, guardrails and human approval mechanisms for enterprise AI agents.Design solutions that operate reliably within enterprise security, data governance and responsible AI requirements.Productionisation & OperationsApply software engineering practices including source control, automated testing, CI/CD, containerisation and API design.Deploy and operate AI workloads in cloud or enterprise environments.Implement monitoring and evaluation to identify model degradation, failed agent executions, hallucinations, excessive token consumption and workflow exceptions.Troubleshoot AI applications across models, prompts, retrieval pipelines, APIs and downstream enterprise systems.Business PartnershipWork directly with business and technical stakeholders to identify workflows suitable for AI-enabled automation.Rapidly develop prototypes and evolve successful prototypes into production solutions.Clearly communicate AI capabilities, limitations, risks and technical trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.Key RequirementsBachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.5–7 years of relevant hands-on experience in machine learning, AI engineering, software engineering or AI application development.Demonstrated experience taking ML/AI applications from prototype through production deployment.Proven ability to independently architect and develop agentic AI solutions for enterprise workflows, rather than relying solely on low-code or pre-built chatbot platforms.Strong programming capability in Python, with solid software engineering fundamentals.Hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector search, tool/function calling and agentic workflows.Experience integrating AI solutions with REST APIs, databases and enterprise applications.Experience with at least one major cloud platform and its AI/ML services.Strong understanding of production considerations including security, scalability, observability, testing, performance and cost optimisation.Good To HaveHands-on experience with agentic/orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen or equivalent frameworks.Experience with enterprise AI platforms and model services such as Azure AI Foundry / Azure OpenAI or equivalent platforms.Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD and MLOps/LLMOps practices.Experience designing human-in-the-loop, approval and exception-handling patterns for autonomous or semi-autonomous agents.Familiarity with model evaluation, AI guardrails, responsible AI, security and AI governance.Experience delivering AI solutions in complex enterprise environments involving multiple systems and stakeholder groups.
